title: eupatorium rugosum f. verticillatum
intro: Eupatorium rugosum f. verticillatum, commonly known as white snakeroot or downy white snakeroot, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as relief from fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium rugosum f. verticillatum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
